english: Haa, haa... I hope\nSiesta's okay now.
(She's safer without me.\nThere's no reason for a commoner to be targeted...)
(I'm a noble - a noble protects the weak.\nEven alone, I'll manage...)
...Wait, where is this?\nI came from that way, right?\nAh, maybe it was this way...
Could it be... I'm lost...?\nNo way...
At a time like this, if only\nI had my familiar...
//SE: rustling, sound of grass brushing
Wh-who's there!?
Ow ow ow... please...\ndon't push. The leaves are stabbing me...\nOw... ow ow... it hurts...
That's not it!\nUm, well, I tripped.
H-huh... really...?\nThen stop clinging to me, quickly...
Sorry sorry,\nI didn't push because\nI wanted to!
I mean, I mean,\nthe footing was bad, so\nI just went THUD, that's all!
What does "THUD" mean...
Um, are you okay?\nLet's stay calm and act carefully.
Still,\nwhere is this place...?\nWe're completely lost...
W-we were lost...!?\nUu... which road is the right one...?
Right or not,\nwe don't know where this is, which way\nto go, or what's that way...
(Oh, [CLAUDE]!\nThere's a beautiful girl over there!)
Huh? Ah... who\nmight you be?
That's MY line!!
Who are you people? What commoners?\nDon't tell me you're the mages\nwho control those monstrous beasts!!
No, we're definitely not suspicious people...
You look suspicious from every angle! Your clothes are weird too!
Eeeh!?\nTh-these are my own clothes, but\nare they... weird...?
//A weakened Cecilia comes out
U... ugh, what's going on?\nIt's noisy.
Cecilia-chan, don't push yourself.
//Event CG: Cecilia unwell (NG if the picture looks like anything but a stomachache, so no CG.
Hauu...
Wh-what's wrong? Your face is pale.
It seems she caught a cold\nfrom the unfamiliar camping...
Was it that cold...?
Sleeping without a futon\nisn't normal...
//Event CG off
Water healing magic would fix that easily,\nbut I can't use water magic.
Magic?\nAre you saying you're a mage?
That's right. I am Louise Francoise\nLe Blanc de La Valliere.\nYou know what that name means, right?
Whoa, a name like a spell!\nShe's definitely a mage!
No! Unlike you commoners, I HAVE a family name!
Mmm...??\nHaving a family name makes you\na mage?
Hawawa! My family name is made up,\nbut am I a mage? Come to think of it,\nmagical = mage, that's the vibe.
Um, being a mage because of a name\nsounds fishy.
Muu! [CLAUDE]-san, not just your family name -\neven your given name is fishy!
Having a family name makes you a mage? What's that~ (laugh)\nMagic is all about guts and fighting spirit!!
Then I don't think you can use magic...
Booo!! You can use magic too, you know!\nBut we don't know your family name!!
What commoners are you?\nThere's a limit to not knowing things!
C-commoners...?\nUm, excuse me, but\nwhat does that mean...?
I'm a noble!\nIt's common sense that nobles can use magic!\nYou know at least that much, right?
A noble?\nI, Cecilia Alcott, am\na noble too!
Cecilia-chan, you'd better not push it...
Alcott? Where's your territory?
It's in England!
Where's England!?\nI've never heard of such a name!\nAren't you a fake noble?
What did you say!!
Cecilia-san, please calm down.\nHearing "magic," I had a thought -\nisn't this some special world...?
Is there a map of this area?
A map of this area would really help?
A map? I have one. Want to see?
I see... as I thought, this is...
It looks like... Europe,\nbut... a little different.
My country isn't on the map!?
I wonder where this is...
Ah! Maybe it's the setting of a wonderful story,\nlike the swords-and-magic fantasy world you reach\nfrom a platform at a station you can't normally see!
Everything you people have been saying\nfeels off somehow...?
Right, you said Cecilia?\nIf you're a noble, you can use magic, right?\nShow me.
Magic? Why would a noble use magic?
You can't use it?\nThen you're just a commoner after all.
What did you say!?
Cecilia-san, if you push yourself\nyou'll get a fever...
Being called a commoner\nburns away my fever with anger!
(Seems like it'll give her more of a fever, though...)
Louise-san! If you're a noble too,\nyou understand what it means\nto tarnish a noble's honor, don't you?
What! If it's a duel, I'll accept!
Let's not fight.\nWe can understand each other's words, after all...
NO!!
No way!!
Um...\nThis doesn't seem like the time to be fighting.
That's enough! Stop! Stoooop!
What is it?
Why'd you stop us!!
It seems we're surrounded...
No way!?
//Switch to battle map\n//After allies and enemies are placed
I'll fight too!
What, you CAN use magic!
My Blue Tears\naren't magic!
You should've shown me from the start!\nWhat element? Earth alchemy plus common-magic\nlevitation combined? What unusual magic.
Explaining the IS... doesn't seem like\nwe have the luxury for that.
I.S.?
Um, sufficiently advanced science\nis indistinguishable from magic!
Um, well,\ndetails don't matter! Let's just\ndo what we gotta do first!
I'll break through at one point!\nFirst, let's break the encirclement!
You can use magic too, huh.
Huh? Me?\nI'm hand-to-hand combat, so\nI don't think it's magic...
I saw you bring out that armor.\nEarth-system alchemy and fixation, I'd say?\nA song-like spell, interesting.
That's why it's not magic...
By the way, are you feeling okay?\nDid you heal with healing magic?
Not magic - fighting spirit!\nA noble doesn't show an unsightly figure to the enemy!
Hmm, so you have pride... fine!\nI'll allow you to cooperate with me.
Why are you talking down to me like that!?
//Battle begins.\n//Event triggers when Louise attacks
My! You're really a mage?
If I couldn't use magic, I couldn't fight!
True, if all you have are bows for ranged weapons,\nmagic sounds insanely strong.
So magic in this world is\nlike how the IS made modern weapons\na thing of the past...
Let me tell you, this isn't even\none-hundredth of my true power!\nDon't think this is all there is!
And using powerful magic\nrequires a long chanting time, so\nyou all hold the enemies back properly!
Leave that to me!
//Defeat a certain number of small fry.\n//Black Puchiko appears
...? A really tiny one showed up.\nA fairy, I wonder.
...You're small too, nyu.
Wh- You're smaller than me!
...Look at your own chest before saying that, nyu.
Wh... wh-wh-wh-what did you say!?
That remark! I absolutely won't forgive it!
...I'll beat you back, nyu...!
Wow♪ This is a cute showdown!
Coming from you,\nthat bugs me somehow...!
//Battle resumes\n//Black Puchiko repelled (certain damage?)
...Retreating, nyu.
//Black Puchiko retreats
Wait!\nI haven't forgiven you yet!
Oh, she got away.
...Chasing her would be stupid anyway.\nBesides, there's something bugging me.
Something bugging you?
About you all, obviously!
//Battle ends
For now, let me thank you. Thanks.\nIt'd have been bad without you all.
You said Louise-san?\nYou're pretty good yourself.\nNot as good as my Blue Tears, though.
Indeed, admirable guts despite being unwell.\nI have to acknowledge that.\nYour magic arm isn't bad, either.
Even though I keep telling you\nit's not magic, how stubborn...
Now now, Cecilia-san.\nYou could just honestly take it\nas a compliment, couldn't you?
Of course!\nI am a genuine noble, after all.
(So a cold can be cured with fighting spirit, huh)
(More a gutsy person than a noble...)
(It's magic called willpower, surely)
Um, could you\nshow me that map one more time?
Sure. Here.
It resembles Europe,\nbut a lot is different...
Europe? This is Halkeginia.\nHalkeginia's Kingdom of Gallia.\nYou're not Gallians?
Yes. It's a long story, but...
//Fade to black, time passes
...Came from a different world...?
(A different... world...)
Huh? What's wrong?
No, it's nothing. ...Yeah, nothing.
So, if in this world too there are incidents\nlike people appearing from different worlds or\npeople disappearing, I'd like you to tell us.
...There are.
Really?
In my country, the Kingdom of Tristain,\na mage who controls monstrous beasts has appeared\nand is causing calamities.
Controls monstrous beasts...?
Since he appeared,\nvillages in the country have been attacked, residents have vanished,\nstrange incidents keep happening one after another.
To stand against him,\nI must meet His Holiness the Pope of Romalia\nand regain my lost power.
You said this is the Kingdom of Gallia?
Romalia is the country on the far side\npast the Kingdom of Gallia from the Kingdom of Tristain.\nI was making a secret journey there... ah!?
What's wrong?\nUm, if it's hard to say,\nyou don't have to...
It's not that!!\nI left the companion I was traveling with...!\nOh no, I have to go look for them!
Louise-chan, calm down!\nActing alone is dangerous!
Right, it's dangerous!\nAnd yet I left my companion alone!\nHow stupid was I...!!
Not necessarily.\nThings turned out well, didn't they?
What do you mean "well"!
Searching together will be faster\nthan alone.
You'll help me?
I'm Tachibana Hibiki! My hobby is helping people!\nPlease let me help!
When in trouble, we help each other.
The mage who controls monstrous beasts\nthat Louise-san mentioned\nmight be someone we know.
Louise-san, we might be\nfighting the same enemy!
They say the enemy of my enemy is my friend?\nThen we're allies, aren't we?
Comrades fighting our common enemy together!\nNice to meet you!
A common... enemy.
(Ugh... so big!!)
(What is this!? Too big!\nIs something wrong with my eyes?\nThere are six lined up like Tiffa...!)
What's wrong?
(She's an enemy too!)
Um, is something wrong...?
Okay, you're an ally!
Huh?
Huh? Why's she mad?
(This too... talk about adversity!\nI should've brought Tabatha...)
Dunno what's going on, but\nthose burning eyes are the best!\nI can feel the will to fight!!
(Look at her chest.\nSurely she has a complex about it)
...Ah, so that's what it was.
What do you mean, "that's what it was"?\nExplain it to me thoroughly.
Huh? Well, that's... I mean, her chest...
//[ES] Louise snaps at Claude. Stomping
Don't you dare say it!! You perverted commoner!!
Eeek!?
I-I won't forgive you... to insult\nme, a noble, this much...
Ah, I get it!\nSo you don't want your life, huh?
Huh... I was just stating\nobjective facts...
Who gave you permission to open your mouth?\nAnd if you're opening it,\napologize before making excuses!!
Y-yes... I'm sorry!\nI'm sorry! I'm sorry!!
Anyway, what IS this!\nThis lineup feels like harassment!!\nI see, it's your hobby, huh? Apologize!!
Dragging along monster-class girls\nand barging into someone else's world uninvited!\nDo you want war that badly!
U-um... Louise-san?
Men are lewd beasts who think\nbigger is better!! They should die\nthe moment they're born!
Y-you'd go that far...
She's completely snapped...
//Event CG off
Haa, haa... I'm tired...
(Th-that was probably two lifetimes'\nworth of scolding... when it's this much,\nit's almost starting to feel good... maybe)
Ugh, haa haa...
A-are you okay...?\nYou've been fidgety for a while...?
(I wonder what'd happen to me\nif she talked to me like that...)
By the way, Louise-san,\nshouldn't you go look for your attendant?
Huh!? Siesta! That's right!
We'd better hurry.
Louise-chan, lead the way!
...Got it.
//Scene change\n//BG: plain (night)
No good... I don't know\nwhere it was...
This is troubling...
What do I do... if something happened\nto Siesta because of me...!
Setting aside me with my IS,\nsearching at night is difficult and dangerous.\nLet's search again in the morning.
No! If we don't hurry, Siesta will!
Even so, Louise-chan,\nyou're already swaying on your feet.
Louise-san must be exhausted\nfrom using magic.
You mustn't push yourself too hard!\nUm, won't you rest properly...?
Yes. Forcing a search in this darkness\nwould be inefficient. I understand\nhow you feel, but please...
Early to bed, early to rise, and resume at sunrise.\nThat minimizes the time loss.
...Okay.
(Siesta... stay safe...)
//Scene change\n//BG: Forest (night)
Louise-san,\nwhere could she have gone?\nWithout even proper food...
I hope she hasn't collapsed\nfrom hunger. I'm worried about\nTiffa-san too, this is troubling...
Siesta! I finally found you!
Miss Valliere!?
I'm sorry! I won't go off on my own anymore!
...Y-yes.
It's dangerous here.\nI found a small cave ahead.\nLet's move there.
That's fine, but.\n...Um, Miss Valliere.
What?
Have your breasts gotten a little bigger?
Huh? Really? Isn't that your imagination?
They were smaller, weren't they?
W-were they? No they're not?
(Sh-she's a fake...!!)
(I thought something was off... her apologizing to me meekly\nwould be impossible even if heaven and earth flipped,\nand not getting grumpy when I mention her chest)
Hmph, you noticed. But too late.
Who are you!?
You'll provide me a little entertainment.\nEntertainment called rebellion against your master.
...Rebel against Louise-san? Me?
This world seems to have an interesting drug.\nYou drank the water from the canteen earlier, right?\nAt that point, you were in my grasp.
//SE: sound of snapping fingers
Ugh...
Repeat after me. Miss Valliere is the enemy.
...Miss Valliere is... the enemy...
Hoh, this is... more effective than expected.
Andvari's ring, which bends humans to one's will.\nAnd the tainted water it was soaked in.\nA terrifying enchantment ability.
Bearer of the Void, Louise the Zero.\nHer mighty magic recovers with emotional ups and downs -\ntruly unbelievable information.
I must use this girl to verify its truth.
//END
